content.text: {"answer":"10%","citations":["D041","D036"],"explanation":"The signed Renewal Order Form (D041) took effect 2026-04-01 and applies a 10% discount (USD 1,920 to USD 1,728 per seat per year) through 2027-03-31, so it covers May 1, 2026. The 15% discount in Amendment No. 2 (D036) was only an unsigned draft with no binding force."}
